rules.title: RSO annual allowable rent increase (July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026)
rules.requirement: For units subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, the annual allowable rent increase for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026 is 3%.
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.quoted_span:
Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
is
3%
.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); RSO status can be checked at zimas.lacity.org.
rules.interaction: The page notes that state law separately requires 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%; non-RSO properties should contact the Housing Department about allowable increases.
rules.conflict_note: The stated 3% figure applies only through June 30, 2026, which has passed as of the query date 2026-10-01; the document does not give the allowable increase for the period beginning July 1, 2026. The RSO itself remains in force.

rules.title: No additional utility percentage increase under RSO
rules.requirement: Starting February 2, 2026, landlords of RSO units may no longer add any additional percentage rent increase for utilities on top of the annual allowable increase.
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).

rules.title: RSO and SCEP fee pass-through surcharges
rules.requirement: Landlords may pass through the RSO fee ($1.61/month) and SCEP fee ($2.83/month) to tenants as surcharges in addition to rent, but only after registering the units and giving written notice to the tenant.
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); Systematic Code Enforcement Program (SCEP)
rules.quoted_span:
The SCEP and RSO surcharges are separate and in addition to the rent amount and can only be collected after the
landlord registers the units and gives written notice to the tenant.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.conflict_note: The SCEP fee amount is stated as effective January 1, 2022, and the RSO fee amount as effective January 1, 2020; the earlier-listed SCEP date is used here.
